annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 897/2024 – Dispõe sobre a Autenticação de Mídia Digital criada ou modificada por Inteligência Artificial (IA) e dá outras providências
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 897/2024 – Provides for the Authentication of Digital Media Created or Modified by Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Other Measures
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Saullo Vianna, União/AM)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian federal bill (PL 897/2024) introduced by Deputy Saullo Vianna requiring mandatory, clear and visible labelling and automated authentication of all digital media generated or modified by AI, making platforms responsible for verification mechanisms, with enforcement by competent bodies. Aims to protect democracy and information integrity against deepfakes and misinformation.
key_provisions_or_claims: All AI-generated or AI-modified digital media must carry a clear, visible mark indicating origin and authenticity
Digital media broadly defined to include images, video, audio, documents on social networks, messaging, websites and apps
Marking and authentication to be done automatically via recognition and verification algorithms
Platforms distributing AI-generated media must implement mechanisms ensuring authenticity
Competent authorities may supervise compliance and apply sanctions
